title: Timeless Wonders of China | Shanghai, Yangtze & Beijing
highlights: Discover Shanghai's modern marvels, cruise the majestic Yangtze River, and explore Beijing's rich history and imperial grandeur, showcasing China’s cultural legacy.
Visit Mausoleum of Mao Zedong in Beijing, unique for housing the preserved body of China's founding leader, offering a rare glimpse into his lasting legacy.
Explore Fengdu Ghost City, a mysterious site with temples, shrines, and statues dedicated to the afterlife, offering a unique glimpse into Chinese beliefs.
Cruise through Qutang Gorge, the narrowest of the Three Gorges, where towering cliffs create a dramatic and breathtaking natural landscape.
Walk along the Mutianyu Great Wall, a beautifully restored site offering stunning panoramic views of the surrounding mountains and a glimpse into China's rich history.

know_before_you_go: Carry a valid ID proof at all times.
The official currency is the Renminbi (RMB). Carry both cash and a credit card, as not all places accept cards.
Mandarin is the official language. English is not widely spoken, so learning basic phrases or using translation apps can be helpful.
Respect local customs, including bowing slightly when greeting and removing shoes in some homes or temples.
China’s public transport is efficient, including bullet trains and subways, but always have the address of your destination written in Chinese for taxis.
Tipping is not customary in China but may be appreciated in some high-end establishments.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Shanghai | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to China! Upon arrival at Shanghai Pudong International Airport, get driven to your hotel. Check in and spend the rest of the day at leisure. You can stroll along The Bund, Shanghai’s famous waterfront, offering breathtaking views of the Huangpu River. You can also discover Chinese art and history at Shanghai Museum, or experience world-class shopping at Nanjing Road, one of the busiest shopping streets in the world. Afterward, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Fly to Chongqing | City Tour of Chongqing | Board Yangtze River Cruise
days.desc: Post check out, get driven to the airport for your flight to Chongqing. Upon arrival, get ready for the city tour. Start at Kuixing Lou, where an optical illusion makes it feel like you're on multiple floors at once. Next, visit the Liberation Monument, a symbol of victory, and explore Jiefangbei’s lively streets. See a train pass through Liziba Station’s residential building, with other attractions. Afterward, board your Yangtze River Cruise from Chaotianmen Dock. Check in & rest for the night.

items.title: Flight - Shanghai Pudong International Airport to Chongqing Jiangbei International Airport
Check-in at Victoria Jenna, Yangtze River Cruise

days.title: Visit Fengdu Ghost City
days.desc: In the morning, get ready for an excursion to Fengdu Ghost City. Upon arrival at Chaotianmen Dock, start your tour. This ancient site has temples, bridges, and statues showing the journey of spirits. It is believed to be a gateway to the underworld, with the giant Ghost King’s face carved into a rock as a highlight. The place offers a unique look into Chinese folklore and spiritual beliefs. After exploring this ghost city, return back to your cruise for an overnight stay.

days.title: Pass Through Qutang Gorge and Wu Gorge
days.desc: As your cruise glides through the Yangtze River, you enter Qutang Gorge, the shortest yet most dramatic of the Three Gorges. Towering cliffs rise on both sides, creating a narrow passage where the river rushes through. The ancient Meng Liang Stairway, carved into the cliffs, hints at history hidden in the rocks. Moving ahead, Wu Gorge unfolds with its misty peaks. Known for the Twelve Peaks of Wushan, each peak has a story to tell. The changing landscapes make this journey truly unforgettable.

items.title: Qutang Gorge and Wu Gorge Tour

days.title: Disembark | Visit Three Gorges Dam | Train to Shanghai
days.desc: After breakfast, disembark at Yichang Port to visit the Three Gorges Dam. Famous for being the world's largest hydroelectric power station, the dam controls the Yangtze River's flow and is a marvel of modern engineering. After exploring, get driven to Yichang station to board your bullet train to Shanghai. As the train races through scenic landscapes, you’ll soon be in China’s financial hub. End the day with a packed dinner before getting driven to your hotel. Check in & rest for the night.

items.title: Transfer in Bullet Train
items.desc: 1 X Bullet Train will be Provided

days.title: Half-Day Shanghai City Tour | Visit to Oriental Pearl Tower | Hungpu River Cruise Experience
days.desc: Today, visit to the peaceful Jade Buddha Temple, and admire the stunning jade statues from Myanmar. Next, wander through the Yu Garden, a true gem from the Ming Dynasty. Then, explore the Longhua Temple & its grand pagoda, steeped in history. Later, ascend the Oriental Pearl Tower, soaking in panoramic views of Shanghai's skyline. Conclude with a relaxing cruise along the Huangpu River, where you witness the striking contrast between the modern skyscrapers of Pudong and the historic Bund.

days.title: Train to Beijing | Visit to Mutianyu Great Wall & Summer Palace
days.desc: Today, get driven to metro station for your train to Beijing. Upon arrival, check in & your adventure starts with the Mutianyu Great Wall, where you can ride the cable car up and explore ancient watchtowers with stunning mountain views. Next, visit the Summer Palace, home to more than 3,000 historic structures, such as the Tower of Buddhist Incense, the Marble Boat, and the Seventeen-Arch Bridge. Afterward, get driven to your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

items.title: Check-in at Deluxe Hotel
items.hotel: Holiday Inn Express Beijing Airport Zone

items.title: Full-Day Great Wall & Summer Palace Tour, Beijing

days.title: Beijing Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Start your day with getting transferred for Beijing sightseeing tour. Begin at Tiananmen Square, the largest public square in the world. Admire the Monument to the People’s Heroes and the Mausoleum of Mao Zedong. Then, explore the Forbidden City, a UNESCO World Heritage site and the former imperial palace. Next, discover the Jade Factory to understand jade’s cultural importance, and end with a visit to the Temple of Heaven, a stunning architectural marvel. Afterward, get driven to your hotel.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, check out from your hotel and get transferred to the airport for your flight back home. This marks the end of your trip.
